    Almost-split sequences ending in string-arrow cokernels #

    For a displayed arrow a : x ⟶ y, the Auslander--Reiten translate of V(a) is the kernel of νP(x) ⟶ νP(y). The source projective P(x) is indecomposable, hence its Nakayama image is an indecomposable injective with simple socle. The nonzero Nakayama kernel therefore also has simple socle. This is the homological input for proving that the almost-split middle term of V(a) is indecomposable.
